lens: The advisory complex kept selling off (GS -5.5%, EVR -7.8%, LAZ -6.2%) even as the tape steadied — but signings didn’t slow: ICE agreed to buy MarketAxess for ~$6B (BofA / JPMorgan), Eli Lilly’s $6.75-plus-CVR take-out of AtaiBeckley hit a preliminary proxy (Moelis, Centerview, Citi / Goldman), Blackstone bought Koch’s DarkVision (Stifel, Guggenheim / Evercore), MIMEDX agreed to buy Sanara for ~$350M (Centerview / Truist), and the $2.2B PBT combination signed (JPMorgan, RBC) — a filing- and signing-heavy day that keeps secure rooms busy regardless of bank-stock prices.

stories.headline: BofA advises ICE and JPMorgan advises MarketAxess on ICE’s $167/share, ~$6B acquisition of the fixed-income trading platform
stories.why_it_matters: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) agreed to acquire electronic fixed-income trading venue MarketAxess (MKTX) in an all-cash deal at $167.00/share — ~$6.0B equity value / ~$5.7B enterprise value, a 33% premium to MarketAxess’s Jul 29 close. The release names BofA Securities as financial adviser to ICE (buy-side) and J.P. Morgan as financial adviser to MarketAxess (sell-side). A public-company take-out of a regulated trading platform runs antitrust and market-structure review alongside confirmatory diligence toward a shareholder vote.
stories.suggested_action: Open with BofA (ICE) and JPMorgan (MarketAxess) — a $6B take-out of a regulated exchange platform runs concentrated antitrust, market-structure, and confirmatory diligence a secure room is built for.

deal_clock.event: ICE agrees to acquire MarketAxess at $167.00/share (~$6.0B)

stories.headline: Moelis and Centerview advise AtaiBeckley’s board (Citi additional; Goldman for Lilly) as the $6.75 + CVR sale to Eli Lilly hits a preliminary proxy
stories.why_it_matters: AtaiBeckley (ATAI) filed its preliminary merger proxy (PREM14A, Jul 30) on its sale to Eli Lilly — $6.75/share cash plus a non-transferable CVR worth up to $2.50 tied to VLS-01/BPL-003 clinical and regulatory milestones (up to $9.25/share; ~$2.8B upfront, ~$3.8B max). The filing names Moelis and Centerview as financial advisers to the AtaiBeckley board (both delivered fairness opinions Jul 15), Citi as an additional AtaiBeckley adviser, and Goldman Sachs as adviser to Lilly (buy-side). A CVR-structured biopharma take-out runs milestone-heavy diligence toward a shareholder vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Moelis/Centerview/Citi (AtaiBeckley) or Goldman (Lilly) — a CVR-structured take-out advancing to a vote runs concentrated confirmatory and milestone diligence a secure room organizes.

deal_clock.event: Lilly agrees to acquire AtaiBeckley ($6.75 + up to $2.50 CVR)

stories.headline: Evercore advises DarkVision (Koch) as Blackstone agrees to acquire the inspection-tech maker; Stifel and Guggenheim advise Blackstone
stories.why_it_matters: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners agreed to acquire DarkVision Technologies — an ultrasound/non-destructive inspection-technology maker for energy and industrial infrastructure — from Koch Engineered Solutions (terms undisclosed). The release names Evercore as financial adviser to DarkVision/Koch (sell-side) and Stifel and Guggenheim Securities as financial advisers to Blackstone (buy-side). A sponsor buyout carved out of a strategic runs contract, IP, and separation diligence to close.
stories.suggested_action: Reach out to Evercore (DarkVision/Koch) and Stifel/Guggenheim (Blackstone) — a carve-out of an industrial-tech asset to a sponsor runs IP, contract, and separation diligence a secure room keeps organized.

deal_clock.event: Blackstone agrees to acquire DarkVision from Koch

stories.headline: Centerview advises MIMEDX on its ~$350M cash-and-stock acquisition of Sanara MedTech; Truist advises Sanara
stories.why_it_matters: MIMEDX Group (MDXG) agreed to acquire Sanara MedTech (SMTI) in a cash-and-stock deal at $35.00/share ($33.00 cash + 0.4735 MIMEDX shares), ~$350M enterprise value, roughly doubling MIMEDX’s surgical revenue and extending it into collagen, wound irrigation, and bone-fixation products. The release names Centerview as exclusive adviser to MIMEDX (buy-side) and Truist as exclusive adviser to Sanara (sell-side). A stock-inclusive strategic acquisition runs S-4 and confirmatory diligence toward close.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Centerview (MIMEDX) on the Sanara acquisition — a cash-and-stock strategic combination runs S-4 registration and confirmatory diligence a data room supports.

deal_clock.event: MIMEDX agrees to acquire Sanara at $35.00/share (~$350M EV)

Signing a royalty-to-operating-company conversion runs asset, title, and reserve diligence into a unitholder vote.

deal_clock.event: SoftVest & Blackbeard sign definitive agreement for $2.2B PBT combination

stories.headline: Advisory stocks slide again even as the tape steadies: GS -5.5%, EVR -7.8%, LAZ -6.2% while the S&P holds ~flat
stories.why_it_matters: US equities steadied Jul 30 — S&P 500 ~flat (+0.1% to ~7,416), Dow +0.5% (~51,953), Nasdaq -0.1% (~25,105), Russell 2000 -0.6% — with the VIX easing to ~18.4 and the 10Y ticking down to ~4.66%. WTI firmed ~1.6% to ~$84. But advisory names kept selling off hard: Goldman -5.5%, Evercore -7.8%, Lazard -6.2%, Morgan Stanley -2.9%, PJT -1.9% (a two-day drawdown across the group, earnings/estimate-driven). A softer advisory tape doesn’t slow signed processes — it sharpens the case for certainty of execution.
stories.suggested_action: Frame outreach around execution certainty — with the advisory complex under pressure but deal signings steady, clients want their live processes to stay on schedule; room readiness protects the timeline.

talking_point.quote: The advisory names are having a rough couple of days — Goldman, Evercore and Lazard all down hard again — but the deal calendar didn’t flinch: ICE agreed to buy MarketAxess for ~$6 billion, Lilly’s CVR-structured take-out of AtaiBeckley hit a proxy, Blackstone bought Koch’s DarkVision, and the $2.2B Permian royalty-trust combination signed. When bank stocks are volatile, the one thing clients control is execution — how are you thinking about room readiness on the deals you’re carrying into August?
talking_point.use_with: M&A, sponsors, financial-institutions, energy, and healthcare coverage teams (esp. BofA, JPMorgan, Goldman, Moelis, Centerview, Evercore, Guggenheim, Stifel)
talking_point.context: Pairs a Jul 30 advisory-stock drawdown with a dense filing/signing cycle — a natural way to open a room-readiness conversation as deals push toward August milestones.

items.lead: Activist JANA Partners sent Fiserv's board a Jul 30 letter urging a comprehensive review of its entire portfolio and backing a reported sale of its Star/Accel debit-network assets, after an ~80% stock drop from 2025 highs.
items.why_unverified: The JANA letter is public/confirmed, but Fiserv has not confirmed a portfolio review, and the debit-network sale is anonymous-sourced (not formally announced). No adviser named in the letter.

items.lead: Reuters reports the two are weighing a sale of their combined stakes in the owner of the Explorer refined-products pipeline, a deal that could value the asset at ~$3.5B.
items.why_unverified: Anonymous-sourced Reuters report; neither company has confirmed a process, and no adviser is named.

items.lead: Activist Down Range Capital is publicly pressing the ~$2.3B-asset Washington community bank to sell itself, pegging a sale at $125–$165/share and citing 7+ potential buyers, low board ownership, and an unresolved CEO succession.
